author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:
 
Title says it all. This is a follow-up to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52361 and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52267.
 
- add the input parameter `xAxis` (`run`, default, or `time`) to the `EcalLaserAPDPNRatios` history plots (`P{1,2,3}{Mean,RMS}History{One,Two}Tags`, `P{1,2,3}DiffHistory`, `P{1,2,3}PercentDiffHistory`):
  - with `xAxis=time` the x axis is the IOV start time for all the tags: run and lumi based IOVs are placed at the start time of their run, taken from the `RunInfo` of the conditions DB, plus the elapsed lumi sections (23.31 s each)
  - IOVs whose run is not found in `RunInfo` are skipped, an exception is thrown if no IOV of a tag can be placed
  - with `xAxis=time` time based tags can be compared with run or lumi based ones, which is not possible on the run number axis (the exception message now points to `xAxis=time`)
  - the default behaviour (`xAxis=run`) is unchanged
- introduce supporting unit tests in `testEcalLaserAPDPNRatiosPayloadInspector.cpp`, exercising the time axis for a run based tag, a lumi based tag, the two-tag mean/RMS/difference/percent difference histories and `xAxis=run` set explicitly
Example:
 
```bash
getPayloadData.py \
    --plugin pluginEcalLaserAPDPNRatios_PayloadInspector \
    --plot plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP2MeanHistoryTwoTags \
    --tag EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_weekly_hlt \
    --tagtwo EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_prompt_v3_inRunLSIoVs \
    --time_type Run \
    --input_params '{"cmsLabel":"Preliminary","xAxis":"time"}' \
    --iovs '{"start_iov": "401623", "end_iov": "403937"}' \
    --iovstwo '{"start_iov": "1724957650321411", "end_iov": "1734896204644951"}' \
    --db Prod --test
```
 
#### PR validation:
 
`scram b runtests` runs fine.
 
 Run the following script [1] and obtained the plots collected [here](https://marcomusich.web.cern.ch/display/ecal_laser_plots/).
 
#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:
 
Not a backport, not to be backported.

[1]

<details>
<summary></summary>

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# output directory of the plots
OUT=ecal_laser_plots
mkdir -p ${OUT}

# lumi sections of the per-LS comparison, the same list for the 2025 and the 2026 run
LUMIS=(1 50 100 150 200)   # TODO: put your list of lumi sections

# runs of the per-LS comparison
RUN_2025=398785
RUN_2026=401623            # TODO: put the 2026 run, in 401623-403937

PROMPT_TAG=EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_prompt_v3_inRunLSIoVs
HLT_TAG=EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_weekly_hlt

# per-LS distribution comparison: prompt LS IoVs of run $1 vs the HLT IoV $2, output tag $3
compare_lumis() {
  local run=$1 hltIOV=$2 year=$3
  for ls in "${LUMIS[@]}"; do
    iov=$(( (run << 32) | ls ))           # packed run/LS IoV
    name=$(printf "LS_%04d" "$ls")
    getPayloadData.py \
      --plugin pluginEcalLaserAPDPNRatios_PayloadInspector \
      --plot plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosHistCompareTwoTags \
      --tag ${PROMPT_TAG} \
      --input_params "{\"cmsLabel\":\"Preliminary\"}" \
      --tagtwo ${HLT_TAG} \
      --time_type Run \
      --iovs "{\"start_iov\": \"${iov}\", \"end_iov\": \"${iov}\"}" \
      --iovstwo "{\"start_iov\": \"${hltIOV}\", \"end_iov\": \"${hltIOV}\"}" \
      --db Prod --test
    mv *.png $OUT/${name}_${year}.png
  done
}

# history plots: plot $1, HLT run range $2-$3, prompt run/LS range $4-$5, input params $6, output name $7
history() {
  getPayloadData.py \
    --plugin pluginEcalLaserAPDPNRatios_PayloadInspector \
    --plot $1 \
    --tag ${HLT_TAG} \
    --tagtwo ${PROMPT_TAG} \
    --time_type Run \
    --input_params "$6" \
    --iovs "{\"start_iov\": \"$2\", \"end_iov\": \"$3\"}" \
    --iovstwo "{\"start_iov\": \"$4\", \"end_iov\": \"$5\"}" \
    --db Prod \
    --test
  mv *.png $OUT/$7.png
}

compare_lumis ${RUN_2025} 398785 2025
compare_lumis ${RUN_2026} ${RUN_2026} 2026

# 2025: runs 398675-398858, 2026: runs 401623-403937
# each plot with the run number axis and with the time axis (xAxis=time)
for axis in run time; do
  params="{\"cmsLabel\":\"Preliminary\",\"xAxis\":\"${axis}\"}"
  suffix=$([ "$axis" = time ] && echo "_vsTime" || echo "")
  history plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP2PercentDiffHistory 398675 398858 1712296086732812 1713082065748092 "$params" P2_PercentDiffHistory_2025${suffix}
  history plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP2PercentDiffHistory 401623 403937 1724957650321411 1734896204644951 "$params" P2_PercentDiffHistory_2026${suffix}
  history plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP2MeanHistoryTwoTags 398675 398858 1712296086732812 1713082065748092 "$params" P2_MeanHistoryComparison_2025${suffix}
  history plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP2MeanHistoryTwoTags 401623 403937 1724957650321411 1734896204644951 "$params" P2_MeanHistoryComparison_2026${suffix}
done
```
</details>
title: support time axis in `EcalLaserAPDPNRatios` history plots
